label: Autopilot
title: Autopilot
lead: Let the assistant open, approve, follow up and close tasks within limits you set. Pushes, pull requests, merges and the Inbox stay with you.
killed: Stop Autopilot is pressed: every Autopilot action is refused in every project. Running steps go on. Lift it in the status bar or Settings.

halted.text: Autopilot stopped itself here: two of its steps failed the same way. Look at the failure, then turn it on again.

consent.title: Turn on Autopilot for this project
consent.lead: The task assistant will run the task flow for you within the limits below. Every action is checked by Crewyard, logged with its reason and shown in the task's timeline.

mayItems.create: create tasks based on what you write in the conversation
mayItems.edit: edit its tasks before they start
mayItems.approve: approve their crews when the Estimated cost fits the limits and every key is under its caps
mayItems.message: queue messages to its running steps
mayItems.complete: mark a finished analysis done after reading its report

yoursItems.spend: spend past any cap, and Unknown estimates
yoursItems.inbox: Inbox questions and approvals, Medium and High risk included
yoursItems.limits: these limits and turning Autopilot on or off

limits.invalid: Check the limits: the day limit cannot be under the task limit.

action.halted: Stopped itself: the same failure twice

status.done: Autopilot told the assistant: one of its tasks finished.
status.failed: Autopilot told the assistant: one of its tasks failed.
status.needs_input: Autopilot told the assistant: one of its tasks waits for you in the Inbox.
status.review: Autopilot told the assistant: one of its tasks is ready for your review.
status.merged: Autopilot told the assistant: you merged one of its tasks.
status.limited: Autopilot told the assistant: one of its tasks paused for a limit or cap.
status.cancelled: Autopilot told the assistant: one of its tasks was cancelled.

notice.on: You turned Autopilot on; the assistant was told.
notice.off: You turned Autopilot off; the assistant was told.
notice.killed: Stop Autopilot was pressed; the assistant was told.
notice.resumed: The stop was lifted; the assistant was told.
notice.halted: Autopilot stopped itself after the same failure twice.

status.stopTitle: Refuses every Autopilot action at once. Running agents go on.

settings.title: Autopilot
settings.hint: Turned on per project in the task assistant. The switch here stops it everywhere at once; running agents go on.
settings.killHint: While on, every Autopilot action is refused in every project.

errors.autopilot_consent: Accept what Autopilot may do before turning it on.
errors.autopilot_limits_invalid: Those limits are out of range.
